decisions.reason: As a declared flagship with prior gold-medal recognition and no sign of performance below aspiration, management would keep it and continue allocating seasonal resources to it.

This rye variant is more niche, but after weaker adjacent bread launches were already removed, it remains a plausible differentiated use of existing baking resources unless sales fall visibly below internal and peer-based aspirations.
The marzipan Christmas stollen fits the firm’s seasonal confectionery strengths, and without evidence of a clear shortfall the firm would likely retain it as part of a focused holiday assortment.
